main_text.head: SECT. VI.
main_text.p: Casus 4.Secundum sequitur, de Juramento rei Necessariæ. Rem necessariam intelligo, quæ nobis ex officio incumbit vi præcepti divini etiam citra Juramentum; ita ut si eam debitis loco & tempore etiam injurati non faceremus, omnino peccaremus: ut alere parentes egenos, depositum reddere & similia. Quo pertinent illa Juramenta, quæ à subditis exigi solent de fidelitate Regi servanda, & de suprematu regio agnoscendo tuendóque, quæque conceptis verbis ab iis præstantur, qui ad Magistratum aut munus aliquod publicum admittuntur, ut quæ sui sunt muneris fideliter faciant.

{b}De obligatione hoc genus juramentorum nulla poteft esse controversia. Ad quæ enim præstanda vel injurati tenemur, jurati certè multò tenemur magis: accedente sc. ei quæ præfuit ex præcepto, nova obligatione ex Jure-jurando.[illegible, ~6 letters] ϑ [illegible, ~4 letters][illegible, ~5 letters] hoc.in Hippodam.

page.notes: Left margin Greek notes (marked b) are only partly legible on the scan; the Greek is given as illegible rather than guessed. "in H ppo- dam." is read as "in Hippodam." with a doubt about the H and the ending. "sc." is read from a long s and may be "fc." in print. The word after "fui" is read as "sui" from a long s. The "hoc." note has an illegible Greek word before it. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
